name: Badlands Reagent Run II
label: Quest
description: Badlands Reagent Run II: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have been most helpful to me, adventurer. I would reward you with the very recipe for the brew I gave you earlier... But I would ask of you a task that is quite dangerous. Hear my request.

This lockbox contains three empty thaumaturgy vessels; they are imbued with an attunement aura that will drain the blood of a scorched guardian dragon. Using one on the beast will anger it greatly, so be warned. Once you have all three filled, bring them to me.
Do this, and the recipe will be yours.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you used the vessels to get me the scorched guardian dragon blood I need? Yes, I know it is a dangerous task... But the recipe for my restorative brew awaits your success. Risk and reward, my friend... Risk and reward...

clips.title: Completion
paras: From one alchemist to another, I salute you. Here, take this recipe and commit it to your knowledge. May it bring you the success and rewards that it has brought me over the years.
